Class ManagerGUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
ManagerGUI
public class ManagerGUI extends javafx.application.Application
Manager view for the boba shop POS. Lets a manager view and edit the Employees, Menu, Inventory, and Orders tables, add and view restocks, and view two reports: weekly inventory usage and an X-report of drink sales on the latest day of business.
Author:
Nihal Arumalla, Ruben Hernandez, Ashwin Sathaye, Oskar Zhang
